kpi_specs.name: Total Revenue

kpi_specs.name: Revenue by Country
kpi_specs.description: Total revenue grouped by billing country, identifying top markets for the business.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT "BillingCountry", SUM("Total") AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY "BillingCountry" ORDER BY revenue DESC

kpi_specs.name: Monthly Revenue Trend
kpi_specs.description: Total revenue aggregated by month to analyze sales trends over time.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "InvoiceDate") AS month, SUM("Total") AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

kpi_specs.name: Average Tracks per Invoice

kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT AVG("distinct_tracks_purchased") AS avg_tracks_per_invoice FROM data
